author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: Conservative whole-organism concept for Lygodium kaulfussi. Fossil foliage informs lobed blades; the unpreserved winding rachis uses an explicitly labelled living-genus analogue. Complete extension, substrate, proportions, repeated units, colour and pose are artistic, not fossil measurements.
description.zh: Lygodium kaulfussi 的保守整体现生复原概念；化石支持裂片叶形，未保存的缠绕叶轴借用明确标注的现生属级类比。延伸范围、攀附基物、比例、重复数量、颜色和姿态为创作。
